module: Node "Load Project" (once_p_duration). Loads a flowgraph (.flow.json) by path and starts it as a child project via self.mgr.modules.thread:startProjectFromFilepath. Input: path (string); output: id (number) of the started project, usable with Send/Receive Message.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

workOnce.desc: Resolves the path (with or without the .flow.json extension), starts the project and writes its id.
